The meaning of the crest

Every line of the logo was drawn on purpose

Not only is the beauty in the artwork visual. The symbolism it depicts gives a breathtaking understanding of God's mercy and grace upon His own.

Wings of angels

The wings BBG is mounted upon are those of angels, for protection.

Wings of eagles

They are supported by wings of eagles, representing the vision and purpose God has for your life.

Tail of a dove

The tail feathers are those of a dove, which represent God's provision and His peace as you accomplish His will.

Pure white

The deliberate use of white signifies a soul made clean by the blood of the Lamb, adopted into a royal priesthood and living a new life in Christ Jesus.

Knowing that these ideas are of the Kingdom, my husband and I pray over each piece, evoking the anointing of the Holy Spirit to bless and minister to each customer.

You're BBG!

Geralda, founder of BBG Group

Good to know

Questions, answered

How do I place an order?

Add pieces to your order on this site and send it to us, or call 313-893-4470. We'll confirm your items, total and delivery, then prepare and pray over your order.

How should I wash my BBG pieces?

Machine wash warm with like colors and tumble dry low. Skip bleach and fabric softener on the embroidery, and your whites and the red crest will stay bright for years.

Can I add a name or date?

Yes. Custom embroidery can be added beside the crest for weddings, anniversaries, church events and gifts. Ask us when you order.

Do you sell wholesale?

We do. Boutiques, gift shops, churches and hospitality partners can request case pricing with the wholesale form above.

Where are you located?

BBG Group, LLC is a family business at 1630 Wellesley, Suite 300, Detroit, Michigan 48203.
